title: OpenJutsu character swap
description: Swap the person in a clip for the character in one picture. The scene, the camera, the performance and the clip's own sound stay. Runs MiniMax H3 with the character-swap LoRA on this computer; one clip of 5 to 15 seconds with the person in its first frame. A clip where the person leaves the frame stops with a message.

controls.label: Direction
controls.default: Replace the selected person in <Video 1> with the character in <Picture 1>. Take only the person from <Picture 1>: face, hair, body and clothes. Ignore the background, setting and light of <Picture 1>. Keep everything else of <Video 1> unchanged: background, framing, aspect ratio, other people, camera, light, performance and audio timing.

A direct run on ComfyUI 0.43.0 (cu130) on the RTX 4090 swapped clip-talking-head.mp4 for portrait-man-studio.jpg at 480p in 232 s with sound kept. No run through the app yet.

2026-10-31: run 6af5b186 through the app API on the "This computer (H3)" worker: clip-talking-head.mp4 with portrait-woman-studio.jpg, panel defaults (480p, 5 s), 271 s. Output 512x928, 120 frames, source audio kept. Looked at frames 0/60/119: the woman from the picture (face, hair, black turtleneck) replaces the speaker, her mouth follows the speech, the room is unchanged, no halo this time; the headphones partly stay. Second validation with a different character; the first (direct run, man) showed halo arcs around the head.
